description: Local-only CLI for searching PokerDB/Hendon Mob-style CSV and JSON exports without using an API.

novel_features.name: Local export normalization
novel_features.description: Normalizes user-supplied CSV/JSON exports with common PokerDB/Hendon Mob column aliases into a portable local JSON cache.

novel_features.name: Cross-surface local search
novel_features.description: Searches players, events, and result rows from the same local data file without network access.

novel_features.name: Compliance doctor
novel_features.description: Reports the local-only mode, selected data file, and disabled network/API status.

novel_features.name: Schema explainer
novel_features.description: Documents accepted local formats and field aliases for user-provided exports.
